policy.bootstrap: 1000 whole-sample cluster draws per bin; equal sample weights, within-sample points retained together; no source-independence claim.
policy.comparisons: Same observed points; primary descriptive rankings on samples with relaxed success for all four families. Strict common-cohort sensitivity reported separately.
policy.critical_bounds: All optimizer coordinates except a zero residual-water fraction; zero residual water is an admissible nested model.
policy.information_criteria: Gaussian ML; K=p+1 includes estimated residual variance; additive Gaussian constants omitted. AICc undefined for n<=K+1.
policy.intervals: Empirical residual quantiles describe fitted-point errors, not validated prospective prediction intervals. Bootstrap bands quantify uncertainty of summaries; parameter intervals are separate conditional local-linear intervals.
policy.minimum_observations: n >= free curve parameters + 1; at least that many distinct pressures
policy.objective: unweighted squared water-content residuals within each curve
policy.relaxed: Converged; finite and physical; n>p; nonconstant predictions. Boundary and rank warnings retained; descriptive only.
policy.restarts: Twelve deterministic starts: six pressure quantiles crossed with two shape starts; BC additionally every pressure-partition midpoint.
policy.strict: Converged; finite and physical; n>p; no critical box hit; full normalized-Jacobian rank; condition <=1e10; nondegenerate fitted range.
policy.water_upper_explanation: Volume fraction <=1 is physical. The mass-basis upper bound 5 kg/kg is a numerical box, not a universal physical maximum; hits are rejected strictly.

policy.discrete_prediction_curve: linear in log10 pressure, positive endpoints only, no extrapolation
policy.evidence: Preserve E0-E5; E5 permitted with approximate predictor mappings flagged.
policy.ksat: Atomic only; m/s, log10 scoring; nonpositive predictions explicitly invalid.
policy.meaningful_ensemble_improvement: At least 1% pooled RMSE reduction and lower RMSE in every held-out group; descriptive, not a population significance claim.
policy.primary_cohort: Largest roster covering at least half the maximum executable sample coverage; ties by sample count then point count.
policy.reduced_ensemble: Best training atomic plus best member among top five training models with residual correlation below 0.95; otherwise two best. Equal weights. Re-select inside every outer fold.
policy.robustness: Leave one source out; otherwise profile; otherwise 500 sample bootstrap draws, seed 20261026.
policy.water_basis: Separate original volume and mass cohorts; no harmonization.
